name: Kanata Stein
source:
The technical director of SPACE Corporation. She is a cool girl genius who earned a doctorate degree at a young age. She was born from the capsule baby project, one of the many plans to increase the human population. Her gene donors are two genius doctors who work for the corporation.

Because she spent her days reading research papers to earn praise from her parents, she is not good at socializing and sometimes appears cold. However, she is capable of admitting her faults and apologizing.

Since she was unable to make friends, she created her own AI friend when she was 8 years old. It was a disastrous work of art that could hardly be considered cute. She insists that it was cute and that no one will stop her from thinking otherwise.
